Definition: akin to an obsolete τάφω (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise), i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses thámbos where it means amazement, astonishment. In Luke 4:36, they were all amazed, and it appears again in Acts 3:10.
TheologicalSignificance: Amazement falling on everyone who saw the lame man walk tells me God's power still leaves crowds with no words at all.
